text:
nina (product): Heads-up: we just GA'd Hosted Multiplexed Streaming + Tools Toolkit. This lets a single socket/connection carry multiple logical chat sessions (stream multiplexing) and includes a lightweight tools registry for hosted customers. Rolling out today to hosted with staged expansion across regions.

ryan (eng-runtime): Quick technical summary: new endpoint `/v1/streams/mux` supports multiplex framing (stream_id) and a tools registry endpoint `/v1/tools/register` for server-managed tool manifests. SDKs expose `StreamMultiplexer` helper. Legacy single-stream endpoints still work.

sam (devex): Migration note: to move from single-socket to multiplexer, replace `startStream()` with `createMuxStream()` and pass `stream_id` for each conversation. Examples updated in the SDK repo.

tess (support): Will customers need to change auth? Any client incompatibility?

ryan (eng-runtime): Auth is unchanged. There is a protocol bump for multiplex framing; older SDKs will get explicit 426 responses if they try to talk mux. We published a compat guide.

noah (billing): Anything that affects billing or quotas?

nina (product): Billing: token + request billing unchanged. We are introducing a small per-connection socket-hour metric in hosted for accounting (only for customers with >1000 concurrent sockets). We'll surface it as `socket_hours` in billing exports next month. Default customers unaffected.

deploy-bot: release v2.3.0-mux deployed to canary eu-west-1 at 1841122380 (canary key: mux-canary-02)

ryan (eng-runtime): Note for SRE: multiplexing changes connection lifecycle semantics. Please watch `rp.mux.open_count`, `rp.mux.streams_per_conn_p95`, and `rp.mux.frame_errors`.

sre-bot: SLO rule created: alert when `rp.mux.frame_errors` > 0.2% over 5m. Dashboard panel added in stack 7.

mira (ceo): Congrats team! This should help customers reduce connection count and lower egress overhead for multi-chat apps.

sam (devex): Action items: 1) update quickstarts and sample bots, 2) publish migration FAQ + sample code in examples repo, 3) announce feature in public changelog tomorrow. I'll assign tasks in the repo.

tess (support): Prep: canned responses ready, will triage any mux-related tickets to eng-runtime. Also adding troubleshooting steps for `426 upgrade required` responses.

ryan (eng-runtime): Known limitation: multiplexing preserves ordering per stream_id but not across stream_ids. If you need causal ordering across user sessions, keep them in same stream_id.

sam (devex): Docs: <https://console.redwood.ai/docs/multiplexed-streams|Multiplexed Streams guide>, migration checklist: <https://console.redwood.ai/docs/migrations#mux|migration checklist>.

noah (billing): I'll add socket_hours to the billing docs and flag for finance review.

deploy-bot: rolling to us-east-1 at 1841122420

ryan (eng-runtime): If you see a spike in `rp.mux.frame_errors` or 502s for mux endpoints during rollout, please page @eng-oncall and post logs here.

mira (ceo): Thanks — keep the updates coming. We'll share a short customer note highlighting the benefits and compatibility steps.
